import array

def _t():
    a = array.array('H', [256, 256, 256, 256])
    x = memoryview(a)
    m = x.cast('B')
    b = m.cast('H')
    c = b[0:2]
    d = memoryview(b)
    del b
    assert c[0] == 256, ('assertEqual', c[0], 256)
    assert d[0] == 256, ('assertEqual', d[0], 256)
    assert c.format == 'H', ('assertEqual', c.format, 'H')
    assert d.format == 'H', ('assertEqual', d.format, 'H')
    _ = m.cast('I')
    assert c[0] == 256, ('assertEqual', c[0], 256)
    assert d[0] == 256, ('assertEqual', d[0], 256)
    assert c.format == 'H', ('assertEqual', c.format, 'H')
    assert d.format == 'H', ('assertEqual', d.format, 'H')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

def _t():
    m1a = memoryview(b'\x00\x02\x00').cast('?')
    assert m1a.tolist() == [False, True, False], ('assertEqual', m1a.tolist(), [False, True, False])
    m1b = memoryview(b'\x00\x04\x00').cast('?')
    assert m1b.tolist() == [False, True, False], ('assertEqual', m1b.tolist(), [False, True, False])
    assert m1a == m1b, ('assertEqual', m1a, m1b)
    m2a = memoryview(b'\x01\x03\x05').cast('?')
    assert m2a.tolist() == [True, True, True], ('assertEqual', m2a.tolist(), [True, True, True])
    m2b = memoryview(b'\x02\x04\x06').cast('?')
    assert m2b.tolist() == [True, True, True], ('assertEqual', m2b.tolist(), [True, True, True])
    assert m2a == m2b, ('assertEqual', m2a, m2b)
    allbytes = bytes(range(256))
    allbytes = memoryview(allbytes).cast('?')
    assert allbytes.tolist() == [False] + [True] * 255, ('assertEqual', allbytes.tolist(), [False] + [True] * 255)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import struct

def _t():
    half_data = struct.pack('eee', 0.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    float_data = struct.pack('fff', 0.0, -1.5, 1.5)
    half_view = memoryview(half_data).cast('e')
    float_view = memoryview(float_data).cast('f')
    assert half_view.nbytes * 2 == float_view.nbytes, ('assertEqual', half_view.nbytes * 2, float_view.nbytes)
    assert half_view.tolist() == float_view.tolist(), ('assertListEqual', half_view.tolist(), float_view.tolist())
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
